Fader creció en Mendoza. En 1904 volvió: Fader grew up in Mendoza. He returned in 1904 after studying painting in Munich and founded an academy the following year. These three works explore everyday life through his eyes.
Fotografía de autor desconocido, hacia 1: Photograph by an unknown photographer, circa 1910. Wikimedia Commons.
En sus pinturas de Guanacache, Roig Mató: Roig Matóns painted the lagoon communities of Guanacache and their daily lives. A musician as well as a painter, he helped found the Mendoza Orchestral Society.
Azzoni creció en Mendoza, donde presentó: Azzoni grew up in Mendoza, where he held his first solo exhibition in 1926. He taught painting and drawing at the National University of Cuyo and created a mural at the school.
Víctor Torrini, de barba y chaleco oscur: Víctor Torrini looks down, wearing a dark waistcoat, his portrait in a gilded frame.
Un hombre baja la mirada. El cuello blan: A man lowers his gaze. His white shirt collar catches the light between his dark beard and waistcoat.
Una mujer de pie alimenta a los cerdos q: A woman feeds pigs gathered beside a wooden fence.
Una mujer se inclina sobre el corral. La: A woman leans over the pen. Light from the side draws together her hand, the wooden boards and the animals’ snouts.
Varias figuras se reúnen entre mantones: Figures gather among shawls embroidered with flowers and fringes.
Mirá cómo los bordados pasan de una figu: Follow the embroidery from one figure to the next. Flowers, fringe and fabric fill the width of the painting.
